requiredFindings.title: The fence-free recovery lease is not yet an X2 exception
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Item 3 takes readers.lease LOCK_SH|LOCK_NB with no installation fence. Identity §5, owner §5 and commit-recovery-readonly.v3.md §2 require that: SHARED-READ, no fence, no wait. Accepted X2 r5 item 7 says there is no lease without the fence, and the forbidden list repeats it, with no recovery exception. Item 3 cites the selector sources and does not amend X2. Required: X6 records a narrow amendment of X2 r5 item 7 and its forbidden list. The read-only recovery selector may take non-blocking SHARED-READ on readers.lease while the fence stays prohibited. The sweep's EXCLUSIVE leases stay under the fence.

requiredFindings.title: The degraded standing drops the selected-operation failure
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Item 8 says its table is the §1 projection exactly. §1 projects committed-availability-degraded as success for history, and as operational-failed / HOST.IO_FAILURE / host-io when a required object is unavailable during a selected operation, with detail evidence.missing, evidence.corrupt, evidence.purged or evidence.expired. Item 8 states only success for history with the matching evidence.* detail. A selected operation that required the object would then observe success. Required: item 8 states both §1 projections for that standing.

scope: Law X6 r1. The sweep's single settle write and its EXCLUSIVE-under-fence scope are sound. RF-1: the fence-free SHARED-READ lease needs an X2 r5 amendment. RF-2: committed-availability-degraded omits the selected-operation HOST.IO_FAILURE projection. No product cargo.
